book.name: 2 Ukorinti
book.title: Ubvur uwu uvaa Uburhu aka atsɛnge abi Ukorinti

content: Àka adzowe abinkɛ umbiaka adɛ̃ɛ̃ adzowe
Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umɛn ibee umbi ahwɛng imimutayɛ Unum aka adzowe ikpui ikikɔng abika adɔsa ru Umakidoniya.
Ra ateu nggaa ayetnummbɔ nu itsũwãmbɔ, arhɛrha anggɔmmbɔ itsu umbɔ adzowe ízũwã ra abɔɔ akarhãrhã.
Umum idɛ̃ɛ̃ idɛyiwamum umbi ugɛ umbɔ adzowe uku kpengkpeng ri ikermbɔ, utsɛku umbɔ aka adzowe ngge itɔngngge ikermbɔ. Ri ibibemambɔ,
umbɔ ashɔ̃rhã umɛn akarhãrhã ugɛ umɛn neke umbɔ akpo idorh ri itsu abokmbɔ atosa ayike abika adɔsa ru Urusharhima.
Akorha anangmbɔ ubinkpi umɛn iki ikaifɛrhkɔ. Umbɔ agbaashia adzowe atsimbɔ ru Uteijee mɔcɛ umbɔ adzaa atsimbɔ ru umɛn ri idɔsu ubin Unum aka abee.
Nggee umɛn ishɔ̃rhũ Utitu ugɛ unga amina asunga amashu itseryɛ unga aka atsai na ayika umɛn ri ikɔng izũwã iyi ibibema ru umbi.
Umbi aka akorha anangmbi ra abina kishoo ri imangmang, ra arherhe, ri ihwihwɛng, ri ikponi itɔ̃ itser nu ibibemambi ru umɛn
, àka akorha anangmbi rimi hã ikɛi ri idzowe izũwã iyɛrɛ iki idzek ri ibibema.
Umum isi itsukamum umbi inggang, bɔr umum ibee iviri idzidzɛrhe ibibemambi ri ikpanga ngge nggu abɔɔ aka awe ru ikponi iki iyiyike.
Umbi ahwɛngmbi imimuta Uteijeemɛn Uyesu Ukiristo, unga awu uner abina kishoo, bɔr ri itsimbi unga awe utsũwã, ngge itsú umbi awe abika awe ru ubin ru ubok itsũwãnga.
Itsũwãmum iyɛ ru ubinkpi uku uze ru umbi ra arherhe akɛrɛ. Ishaikɛ umbi awu anggbaashi asi iwea ri idzidzowe ukpekũ, bɔr nggu amɛn aka akponi idzowe.
Nggee icɛrɛ àka amashi itser ha nggu amɛn aka akponi idzowe ha umbi aka atsai na adzowe ubinkpi umbi aka adɛ̃ɛ̃ adzowe.
Umbi aba awembi ra amɛn aka adzowe, Unum awuri iyɛsa ubinkpi umbi aka adzowe. Unum atsu asunga ru ubinkpi unera aka awerakpɔ, asi iwea ru ubinkpi unera aka ashe rakpɔ.
Asi iwea ibibemamum ugɛ abɔɔ awosha nu umbɔ apara umbi ri iker, bɔr umum ibee umbi kishoo awe icaica.

Ri ivang iyɛrɛ umbi aka awe ru arhɛrha abin, àka akũ ayike abɔɔ ra abinkɛ umbɔ aka abee, ngge itsú umbɔ ivangyɛ umbɔ aka awe ra abin arhɛrhɛ, umbɔ awuri ikũ ayikambɔ umbi ra abinkɛ umbi aka abee. Mɔcɛ abina awe icaica.
Ru nyaku itsɛng Arherhu-Num iki igɔr ugɛ, <<Uwuruwi aka akɔng arhɛrhɛ, asi irhɛke unga. Uwuruwi aka akɔng ukunjiir, asi ibɔrkeci ru unga.>>
Utitu nggu awɛrhanga
Bɔr umum itar uwɛɛ ru Unum, unga aka atsu ra amɛn Utitu ru nyaka amɛnmum aka awe ru umbi.
Utitu asi iyɛsa ubinkpi umɛn iki ishɔ̃rhã ukpekũ, bɔr unga atsu amɛnnga abee iyika umɛn, ngge itsu unga asɛng itsinga aba ru umbi.
Umɛn ikɛi idene ungwɛ̃mɛn nggu unga, uwuruwi aka akpo ikpikpoi ri kishoo ikikɔng abika adɔsa ri idzowe Isarhe Iyiki Ize.
Asi iwea rimi ukpekũ, bɔr awu umbɔ asɛng unga azɛ̃rhã nggu umɛn ri ikũ izũwã iyɛrɛ izĩ Urusharhima. Umɛn ikorha ngge ru umɛn ikpoi Uteijee ni ĩdɛyiwe ugɛ umɛn iwemɛn ra amɛn akika ayike.
Umɛn isi ĩbeemɛn anera arhena umɛn ri itser iyiki idzowe urhɛrhi izũwã hã.
Umɛn ibee ikorhe abin aka arhika ra asu Uteijee nu ra asu anera ikɛi.
Ikɛi umɛn idene umbɔ nggu ungwɛ̃mɛn uwuruwi umɛn iki inyã ugɛ unga adzowe itsinga atɔ̃ itser ra abina arhɛrhɛ. Icɛrɛ unga abee ikorha ananga rimi, ubinkutsu unga awea ri ikeramɛn ru umbi akarhãrhã.
Utitu awu uwɛrhi itsermum uwuku uyika umbi. Angwɛ̃mɛn abɔɔ aka awu nggu unga, awu abi itser ikpui ikikɔng abika adɔsa na akowe imor ru Ukiristo.
Nggee aka adɛyiwe aner abɛrɛ ibibemambi, ngge itsú abika adɔsa kishoo ahwɛng ugɛ ififĩrhãmɛn ru umbi iwu idzidzɛrhe.

footnotes.text: 8.7 ibibemambi ru umɛn: Abvur akɔɔ aki itsɛng abok aki isha awu ru ibibemamɛn iki ikorhuwa umbi.
